separation_of_concerns.scientific_state: Scientific verdict only; never changed by storage or reconstruction incidents.
separation_of_concerns.reconstruction_capability: Whether exact reconstruction can be executed now from currently available verified dependencies.
separation_of_concerns.reconstruction_certification: Immutable proof that R00-R19 passed at a specified capsule root and locator-registry root.
separation_of_concerns.recovery_health: Current operational redundancy and availability: HEALTHY, DEGRADED, FAILED.

strategy_capsule: Immutable semantic/content-addressed authority. Provider paths are forbidden.
locator_registry: Separate append-only operational authority with monotonically increasing generation and canonical SHA-256 root.
execution_binding: Every reconstruction run pins exact strategy capsule root, exact locator registry root, resolver contract and fetch-TTL policy.

artifact_identity.git_sha1: transport pin only; never canonical scientific identity

redundancy.strict_certification: Every critical artifact requires >=2 verified independent failure domains OR one verified copy plus a closed, exact, acyclic rematerialization path.
redundancy.ordinary_reconstruction: One verified copy can reconstruct now but recovery_health becomes DEGRADED and R17 cannot certify.

critical_rule: Failure of reconstructability never rewrites scientific_state. It blocks or degrades reconstruction certification only.
